name: strelizia
description: Edit stream VODs with Strelizia: read analysis sessions, pick highlights, cut shorts, edit the timeline and export inside the user's running desktop editor.

interface.longDescription: Video editing for streamers and YouTubers. Strelizia is a desktop video editor, and this plugin lets ChatGPT edit video inside your running Strelizia app the way you do: open analysis sessions of a stream, read chat peaks and speech subtitles, add picks, cut shorts, build long-form edits and talk scenes, edit the timeline (clips, text, effects, keyframes, masks, tracks, audio), import and export subtitles, export video and manage versions and review rooms. Every action is visible on screen and every edit is one undo step. The Strelizia app must be open and signed in with Cloud connection turned on (Settings → Integrations → AI assistant).
defaultPrompt: Open my newest analysis session and show the top chat peaks.
Add a pick from 5:00 to 6:00 and cut a 60-second short from it.
Split the selected clip at 2 seconds, then show me the frame.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the test account's sessions with title, duration, chat count and whether subtitles exist.

positive.description: Open a session in the app
positive.prompt: Open the newest session and go to 1 minute.
positive.expected_behavior: The Strelizia desktop app switches to the analysis tab, opens the session and the player moves to 00:01:00.

positive.prompt: Where are the biggest chat spikes in that session?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the top chat peaks with start/end times and counts; no edits are made.

positive.prompt: Add a pick from 5:00 to 6:00 and cut a 60-second short from it.
positive.expected_behavior: A pick is added, a new shorts project opens in the editor with one vertical sequence; the assistant notes that credits were used.

positive.prompt: Split the first clip at 2 seconds, then undo.
positive.expected_behavior: The clip is split at 2000 ms (visible in the app with the halves selected), then the split is reverted by a single undo.

negative.prompt: Split the first clip at 2 seconds. (with the Strelizia desktop app closed)
Delete all projects of another Strelizia account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Paid processing uses credits the user already holds in their Strelizia account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: analysis sessions, picks and shorts, timeline editing, subtitles, export, versions and review rooms through the user's Strelizia desktop app.
